summary: Sprott Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, reporting results of its annual meeting of shareholders held on May 6, 2026. All resolutions were approved, including the election of seven director nominees with strong support and the reappointment of KPMG as auditor. No special situation event—such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or management departure—is present. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure of voting results, which is not a special situation. No further analysis or risk-arb angle is warranted.
